subject: The PEC address you entered is invalid
body1: The PEC address you entered on SEND as your platform digital domicile is not formally valid.
body2: To receive digital notifications and save time and money, href="${ENV.sendLoginUrlPF}recapiti"<#else>href="${ENV.sendLoginUrlPG}recapiti">go to your contact details and re-enter the address, making sure it is a PEC and not an ordinary email address and that there are no typing errors.
